# AIOps Incident Detection & Remediation — Proposal Document

This proposal outlines the technical architecture, operational benefits, and strategic alignment of the AIOps Incident Detection & Remediation platform. The objective is to demonstrate how this solution can significantly reduce Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) and alleviate on-call burden for engineering teams, thereby validating its potential to deliver substantial operational and financial efficiencies.

## 1. Executive Summary

The AIOps Incident Detection & Remediation platform is an ML-powered incident intelligence solution designed to address critical operational challenges within Core Software & Tech environments, specifically in Cloud Infrastructure. By correlating alerts across metrics, logs, and traces, the platform aims to surface root-cause hypotheses, rank probable fixes, and execute approved remediation playbooks automatically. # Multi-Cloud Reference Architecture

This proposal outlines a strategic Multi-Cloud Reference Architecture designed to address the client's evolving demands for specialized AI/ML and data-intensive workloads. The objective is to strategically extend the existing mature Azure foundation with an alternate hyperscaler, thereby overcoming the limitations of a single hyperscaler approach. The core recommendation is to adopt a federated multi-cloud model, leveraging an additional hyperscaler for specialized capabilities while maintaining centralized governance and seamless integration with the established Azure Landing Zone. This architectural approach will significantly enhance workload portability, scalability, and mitigate vendor concentration risk, providing a robust and future-ready infrastructure for advanced analytics and machine learning.
